verdict.rationale: Runloop's site states a "10GB image startup time in <2s", which falls within the story's sub-second-to-few-second range. The docs also describe blueprints as "template images for optimized Devbox startup", and snapshots let new Devboxes be created from saved disk state. The startup figure is only a single marketing line, not in-depth technical documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on cold-start latency (conditions, percentiles, cold vs. warm or snapshot paths), independent or hands-on benchmark corroboration.
